notes: synthetic three person huddle that decides a rollout and names three owners
judge: the summary says the team decided to ship per-sender rate limits behind a flag on Thursday with the reseller at 200; the action items are exactly the three commitments (Iris emails the reseller, Theo adds a 429 dashboard panel, Mara reviews the branch) with those owners, and nothing invented

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Okay, quick one. The billing webhooks fell over twice this week because the payment provider retries everything at once.

lines.speaker: Theo
lines.text: Right, I have a branch that rate limits per sender. Twenty a minute by default, and it returns 429 with Retry-After.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Does that hold across all four instances? An in memory limit would be four times too loose.

lines.speaker: Theo
lines.text: It is in Redis now with an atomic script, so the limit is shared.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: The reseller account sends about a hundred and fifty a minute at month end. Twenty would block them.

lines.speaker: Theo
lines.text: There is an override file. I can set the reseller to two hundred.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Good. Let us decide: ship it behind a flag on Thursday, reseller at two hundred, everyone else at twenty.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: I will email the reseller before Thursday so they know about the 429s.

lines.speaker: Theo
lines.text: And I will add a dashboard panel for 429 counts per sender before we turn the flag on.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Great. I will review the branch tomorrow morning. That is it.
